requested_capability: Portable Distribution & Workspace Integration — plan-first install/upgrade/uninstall, versioned DistributionManifest/WorkspaceManifest/InstallReceipt, Codex/Claude/Devin/generic host mirrors plus domain skills, checksum-verified offline bundle, workspace-local MCP bootstrap, multi-repo workspace lifecycle and portable doctor.
reason: Owner directive during dogfooding: Platform Forge had strong host-agent mirror portability but could not be safely installed into an arbitrary target workspace or carried offline with governed ownership/integrity. API Forge and Spark Forge AWS already expose explicit distribution/workspace foundations.
real_world_blocker: A target repository could consume generated mirrors only by manual copying or by working from the Platform Forge source checkout. There was no install receipt, safe upgrade/uninstall, bundle integrity contract, portable doctor, offline bundle install, or versioned workspace manifest.
existing_capability_insufficient: `platformforge agents sync` generates mirrors in the Platform Forge repository and `core/workspace.py` models analysis members, but neither provides a distribution lifecycle for an unrelated consumer repository. MCP/package installation also did not own or verify host assets in the target workspace.
alternatives_considered: Remain frozen and document manual copy steps: rejected because it leaves ownership, upgrade, uninstall and integrity undefined.
Copy API Forge implementation verbatim: rejected; Platform Forge must reuse its canonical agent roster, generated host mirrors, workspace-local governance and frozen core semantics.
Add a bounded additive distribution/workspace layer under FE-003 and rebaseline only the affected CLI/schema snapshots: chosen.
architectural_impact: medium/additive — new distribution and portable-workspace packages plus CLI adapters; evidence, Graphfy, economy and operations semantics are unchanged.
schema_impact: three additive v1 public schemas: distribution-manifest-v1, workspace-manifest-v1 and install-receipt-v1; schema snapshot rebaselined under this exception.
agent_impact: none to canonical roster/budgets — portable host agents are generated from the existing roster; canonical skills are packaged once and projected per host.
operations_impact: workspace file lifecycle only — staged writes, ownership hashes, conflict refusal, safe uninstall; no cloud/provider mutation or autonomy increase.
decided_by: owner (explicit request to implement portable distribution and merge)
